comparator.institution: Delft University of Technology, Leiden University and Erasmus University Rotterdam
comparator.academicYear: 2026–2027 adopted OER; printed allocation remains internally inconsistent
comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted/effective 31 August 2026 Clinical Technology OER, Articles 7 and 32 and Appendix 3 (PDF pp.25–27), was freshly retrieved and its tables visually inspected on 8 October 2026. It controls the current requirements over the linked 2024–2025 chart. The current minor is 30 EC. Year three has exactly four major units: Intensive Care and Computer Simulation KT3405 6.5, Complex Diagnosis–Therapy Combinations KT3505 6.5, Clinical Technology Research KT3806 15 and Skills and Safety 3 KT3905 2, totaling 30 EC; the minor adds 30. Bioinformatics KT2555, Medical Image Processing KT2355 and Healthcare Information and Organisation KT2655 are counted once in year two, not copied again into year three; the separate old AV3/essay entry is removed. Current KT1605 and KT2605 titles are Heart and Lung: the Foundation and Heart and Lung: Homeostasis. The listed first-year units total 60 EC. The second-year table prints healthcare placement KT2755 at 4.5 EC and its twelve units total 61 EC. Therefore the exact printed allocation is 60+61+60=181 EC, contrary to the statutory 180-EC degree load. The 27 listed components document this conflict; they do not certify a complete valid 181-EC degree or a reconciled 180-EC pathway. An applicable corrected OER, current authoritative course allocation or university credit-sharing clarification is required. No one-credit reduction, duplicated course, inferred exemption or filler is introduced. Medicine, engineering, clinical skills, safety, patient-facing placement and the 15-EC research capstone remain independently supported.

exception.reason: The current adopted OER specifies a 180-EC degree but its exact course/minor requirements sum to 181 EC: first year 60, second year 61 and third year 60. Healthcare placement KT2755 is printed at 4.5 EC. The minor and duplicated-chart errors are corrected, but no official authority was found resolving the one-credit discrepancy. A coherent 180-EC external reconstruction and subsequent UCR assessment remain blocked; no weight is silently changed to make the total fit.
